The customer asks for an address update and a new chequebook and expresses no dissatisfaction. The contact centre note says it was routed to the complaints queue by mistake.
analysis.summary: The customer, [PERSON_1], emailed on 2026-11-06 to say they have moved house. They gave a new address ([ADDRESS_1], [POSTCODE_1]) and asked for their details to be updated and a new chequebook sent. No dissatisfaction, loss or detriment is described. A contact centre agent noted the email was routed to the complaints queue by mistake from the shared inbox. It should be redirected to the correct servicing team.
